destination_details.trail_details:
Jeep transfer to viewpoint (30 mins),
1km walk across sand sea (20-30 mins),
250 steps to crater rim (15-20 mins). Mostly flat with final ascent via stairs.
destination_details.permit_details: National Park entry fee: Foreign tourists IDR 220,000 (weekdays), IDR 320,000 (weekends). Domestic: IDR 25,000-50,000. JVTO includes all permits.
destination_details.weather_by_season: Dry season (Apr-Sep): Clear skies, excellent sunrise visibility. Wet season (Oct-Mar): Frequent fog, rain, and limited visibility. Cold temperatures year-round at high altitude.
destination_details.rainfall_intensity: Moderate during wet season (100-200mm/month), Low during dry season (20-50mm/month)

risk_factors.mitigation: Wear multiple warm layers, gloves, and beanie. JVTO provides blankets and hot drinks.
Wear sturdy shoes and watch footing on stairs. JVTO guides assist with difficult sections.
risk_factors.description: Volcanic ash and sand can be slippery

risk_factors.mitigation: Take time to acclimatize, stay hydrated. JVTO plans gradual altitude exposure.
JVTO uses scheduled Jeep rotations and alternative viewpoints to avoid crowds
risk_factors.description: High visitor density at sunrise viewpoints

destination_details.trail_details: 3km ascent (1.5-2 hours) to crater rim, 1km descent (30-45 mins) to crater floor. Steep gradient (30-40°), volcanic gravel surface.
destination_details.permit_details: Available at Paltuding entry gate. Foreign tourists: IDR 100,000 (weekdays), IDR 150,000 (weekends). Domestic: IDR 5,000-15,000.
destination_details.weather_by_season: Dry season (Apr-Oct): Clear skies, minimal fog. Wet season (Nov-Mar): Frequent rain, dense fog, higher gas concentration.
destination_details.rainfall_intensity: High during wet season (200-400mm/month), Low during dry season (50-100mm/month)

risk_factors.mitigation: Use provided gas masks, limit time near active vents, immediate descent if feeling unwell. JVTO provides professional equipment and health screening.
risk_factors.description: Toxic sulfur gas exposure causing respiratory issues

risk_factors.mitigation: Use headlamps, trekking poles, and proper footwear. Follow guide closely. JVTO guides are trained in night navigation.
risk_factors.description: Steep, slippery paths especially in darkness

risk_factors.mitigation: Bring warm layers, rain jacket, and check weather forecast. JVTO monitors conditions and may adjust timing.
risk_factors.description: Rapid weather changes and cold temperatures at night

risk_factors.mitigation: JVTO conducts pre-ascent health screening. Guests must disclose relevant medical conditions.

destination_details.trail_details: 800m river trek through canyon (30-45 mins), multiple river crossings, final approach through waterfall spray zone. Total elevation gain: 50m.
destination_details.permit_details: Local entry ticket required: IDR 15,000-25,000 per person. JVTO includes all entrance fees.
destination_details.weather_by_season: Dry season (May-Oct): Optimal conditions with minimal rain, clear water flow. Wet season (Nov-Apr): Heavy rainfall increases flash flood risk, stronger water currents.
destination_details.rainfall_intensity: High during wet season (300-500mm/month), Moderate during dry season (50-150mm/month)

risk_factors.mitigation: JVTO monitors weather conditions and may cancel visits during unsafe conditions. Guides are trained in river safety.
Proper footwear provided in JVTO packages. Guides assist with difficult sections.
Safety briefing provided. JVTO guides are trained in first aid and emergency response.
risk_factors.description: Slips and falls on wet surfaces

destination_details.trail_details: Panoramic viewpoint accessible by short walk, then 45-60 minute descent to waterfall base using bamboo ladders, ropes, and rocky paths. Total distance: 1.5km round trip with 150m elevation change.
destination_details.permit_details: Entry fee: IDR 20,000-30,000 per person. Additional guide fee for canyon descent. JVTO includes all fees.
destination_details.weather_by_season: Dry season (May-Oct): Best conditions with minimal rain, clear skies. Wet season (Nov-Apr): Heavy rainfall increases water flow and flash flood risk.
destination_details.rainfall_intensity: High during wet season (300-600mm/month), Moderate during dry season (50-200mm/month)

risk_factors.mitigation: JVTO provides experienced guides and safety equipment. Descent is controlled and assisted.
risk_factors.description: Steep and slippery descent with rope sections

risk_factors.mitigation: JVTO monitors weather conditions and cancels visits during unsafe conditions. Emergency evacuation plans in place.
Safety briefing and physical assessment. JVTO guides are trained in wilderness first aid.
risk_factors.description: Physical exertion and potential for slips/falls

destination_details.trail_details: Easy access with paved paths to beach, minimal walking required. Rocky areas require careful footing.
destination_details.permit_details: Entrance fee: IDR 40,000 per person included in package.
destination_details.weather_by_season: Dry season (Apr-Oct): Clear skies, calm waters, ideal for beach activities. Wet season (Nov-Mar): Higher waves, occasional rain, stronger currents.
destination_details.rainfall_intensity: Moderate during wet season (150-300mm/month), Low during dry season (30-100mm/month)

risk_factors.mitigation: Swim only in designated safe areas. Follow lifeguard instructions if available.
Wear water shoes with good grip on rocky surfaces
Use sunscreen, hat, and seek shade during peak hours
